annotations.title: EU steel and safeguard tariff quotas by CN code and country

description: Tariff quotas set by EU trade measures, read from the Official Journal act's own tables: the steel regime's country quotas (Regulation 2026/1384, distributed by 2026/1457) and safeguard quotas such as ferro-alloys. Each row has the quota order number, product category, CN codes, country (or other countries), the volumes in tonnes per period, the out-of-quota duty and the act as proof. By default only the current row per order number; history=true adds rows later acts replaced. Quota balances are in TARIC; the Official Journal is authoritative. Free.

celex.description: Only quotas from this act, e.g. 32026R1457

cn.description: CN code, 4 to 10 digits, e.g. 7208 or 72085120

history.description: Also rows replaced by later acts (default false)
